recommendation: Customer IAM: security of your customers
guidance: Avoid custom authentication stored in relational tables, which introduces OWASP risks like SQL Injection and Broken Authentication. Use a purpose-built CIAM service such as Amazon Cognito (free up to 50,000 MAU), which supports MFA, SSO, SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and social federation. Partner alternatives (Okta, Auth0) are available on AWS Marketplace. Enable AWS WAF Account Takeover Prevention (ATP) to block credential stuffing on login endpoints.
how_to_check: Is Amazon Cognito or an equivalent CIAM service used for customer authentication? Is MFA enabled for customer-facing apps? Is AWS WAF ATP enabled on login endpoints? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
